objectives.label: Explică situația concretă
criteria: Convey the situation with the essential details in this semantic example: Rom tolv er fortsatt opptatt. Accept equivalent Norwegian wording and intelligible beginner fragments; never require memorization.
reject: A greeting or bare yes without relevant prior context is insufficient.
Invented facts, repeating the partner without the required communicative act, and unresolved contradictions do not satisfy the criterion.

objectives.label: Formulează cererea sau propunerea
criteria: Request or offer the concrete action conveyed by: Kan vi endre rekkefølgen? A polite equivalent, statement of need or offer is acceptable.
reject: A greeting or bare yes without relevant prior context is insufficient.

objectives.label: Confirmă următorul pas convenit
